title: Adgentek Adapter Params
description: A schema which validates params accepted by the Adgentek adapter. Nothing is required: a missing value must never reject the whole imp (the adapter skips an imp without a slot id or conversation itself).

slotId.description: The Adgentek placement (slot) id minted for this publisher, e.g. ca10d818-1795354687823. Static, set in the Stored Imp.

messages.description: Conversation turns, oldest first. Dynamic. Our bundles send these as bidder-scoped site.ext.data.messages instead; dsp-connector sends them here.

sessionId.description: Stable per-conversation id, used by Adgentek for frequency capping. Dynamic.

custom.description: String-to-string reporting tags sent as Adgentek's custom map. Bounded values only, never personal data.
